description: Canonical edge types. v0.3.0 (2026-05-15): adds conversation cluster (communicated_with, met_with, had_meeting_with) + travel cluster (traveled_to, arrived_at, departed_from) + controls. These edges were promoted from corpus-discovery observations during the May 2026 clean-slate validation — verbs like 'said', 'told', 'asked', 'replied' kept appearing in extracted statements without target edges. v0.2.0 (2026-05-11): testimony cluster, mention cluster, statement cluster, beneficial-ownership cluster, family cluster, travel cluster (initial), issue-anchor cluster.

mentions.label: Mentions
mentions.description: Source references target without making a strong claim about it. The cheapest, most permissive edge.

co_occurs_with.label: Co-occurs With
co_occurs_with.description: Two entities or places appeared together in the same signal or event. Symmetric.

located_at.label: Located At
located_at.description: Spatial anchor — entity or event has a location.

participated_in.label: Participated In
participated_in.description: Entity was an actor in an event.

involved.label: Involved (inverse of participated_in)
involved.description: Event involved an entity. Inverse side of participated_in for query convenience.

same_as.label: Same As
same_as.description: Two nodes are confirmed to refer to the same real-world thing. Used after entity merge.
same_as._doc: Symmetric and merge-driven. Created by resolver after high-confidence match. Lower-confidence matches use 'possibly_same_as' (proposed for v1.1).

part_of.label: Part Of
part_of.description: Hierarchical containment. Place→Place (city in country), Topic→Topic (subtopic in topic), Chronicle→Chronicle (day in week), Entity→Topic (entity is part of a campaign).

follows.label: Follows
follows.description: Temporal succession. Used for Chronicle→Chronicle (yesterday→today) and Event→Event (cause→effect-in-time).

supports.label: Supports
supports.description: Source assessment provides corroborating evidence for target assessment.

contrasts.label: Contrasts
contrasts.description: Source assessment contradicts or undermines target assessment.

derived_from.label: Derived From
derived_from.description: Lineage edge — node was created or extracted from another node or signal.
derived_from._doc: This is the audit edge — every node should have at least one derived_from edge unless it was manually created.

cites.label: Cites
cites.description: Document explicitly references another document (link, citation, quote).

cited_by.label: Cited By (inverse of cites)
cited_by.description: Inverse of cites. Maintained for query convenience.

supersedes.label: Supersedes
supersedes.description: Source node replaces target node. Used for corrections, version updates, and human edits overriding AI-generated content.

superseded_by.label: Superseded By
superseded_by.description: Inverse of supersedes. Maintained on the older node so queries can find the current version.

covers.label: Covers
covers.description: Chronicle node covers (summarizes activity for) other nodes within its time window.

tracks.label: Tracks
tracks.description: Watch intent or case actively tracks this entity / place / topic.

matches_pattern.label: Matches Pattern
matches_pattern.description: Node is a member of an emergent pattern. Created by pattern detection workers (v2).
matches_pattern._v1_status: Defined in v1; populated by workers in v2.

officer_of.label: Officer Of
officer_of.description: Person holds an officer position in an organization. Source: SEC EDGAR, state SOS records.

has_officer.label: Has Officer
has_officer.description: Organization has a person as officer. Inverse of officer_of.

donor_to.label: Donor To
donor_to.description: Person or organization donated to a political committee or nonprofit. Source: FEC, IRS 990.

contracted_with.label: Contracted With
contracted_with.description: Organization received a government contract from an agency. Source: USAspending.

filed_with.label: Filed With
filed_with.description: Entity has filings with a regulatory body (SEC, FEC, state SOS). Source: SEC EDGAR, FEC.

litigant_in.label: Litigant In
litigant_in.description: Entity is a party in a court case. Source: CourtListener, PACER.

subsidiary_of.label: Subsidiary Of
subsidiary_of.description: Organization is a subsidiary or controlled entity of another. Source: SEC 10-K, state SOS.

parent_of.label: Parent Of
parent_of.description: Organization is a parent or controlling entity. Inverse of subsidiary_of.

registered_at.label: Registered At
registered_at.description: Organization is registered at an address. Source: state SOS, SEC.

investigated.label: Investigated
investigated.description: Lineage edge — entity investigation produced this finding. Audit trail for investigation provenance.

_v03_conversation_cluster._doc: v0.3 additions: communication/meeting edges promoted from corpus discovery. The collapse pipeline surfaces conversational verbs (said/met/asked/etc.) and these edges receive them. Symmetric so A→B and B→A collapse to one assessment.

communicated_with.label: Communicated With
communicated_with.description: Two entities exchanged information (verbal, written, electronic). Symmetric. Source: extracted from any verb describing speech, writing, calls, email, or messaging.

met_with.label: Met With
met_with.description: Two entities had a personal meeting or encounter. Symmetric. Includes meetings, lunches, briefings, summits.

had_meeting_with.label: Had Meeting With
had_meeting_with.description: Two entities had a formal meeting (lunch, briefing, summit, etc.). Symmetric. More formal-tone than met_with — same semantic.

traveled_to.label: Traveled To
traveled_to.description: Person traveled to a place at a known time. Surfaces from flight logs, immigration records, news mentions.

arrived_at.label: Arrived At
arrived_at.description: Entity arrived at a place. Asymmetric.

departed_from.label: Departed From
departed_from.description: Entity left from a place. Asymmetric.

controls.label: Controls
controls.description: De-facto control without majority ownership (voting agreements, board control, trust arrangements). Often what enforcement filings care about.

_v02_testimony_cluster._doc: v0.2.0 (2026-05-11) — adds 'who told on who' edges plus mention/document edges plus beneficial-ownership edges plus statement edges. Each new edge below has source/target/fires_automatically set explicitly. These edges power court-record analysis (testimony chains), Acme/UFO corpus navigation (mention provenance), and OpenCorporates+ICIJ chain mapping (ultimate beneficial owner).

testified_against.label: Testified Against
testified_against.description: Person testified or gave evidence against another person, often in a deposition or trial. Asymmetric. Source: court_filing extraction, deposition transcripts.

testified_for.label: Testified For
testified_for.description: Person provided testimony supporting another person or organization (e.g. character witness, alibi).

testimony_received_from.label: Testimony Received From
testimony_received_from.description: Inverse of testified_against — held on the named party so 'who testified about X?' queries are cheap.

accused_by.label: Accused By
accused_by.description: Person was accused of conduct by another person. Used for allegation graphs prior to or independent of formal testimony.

accused.label: Accused
accused.description: Inverse of accused_by — held on the accuser so 'who has X accused?' is cheap.

named_as_associate.label: Named as Associate
named_as_associate.description: Person named another person as an associate, contact, or known party. Weaker than testified_against; covers passing mentions in depositions and address books.

informed_on.label: Informed On
informed_on.description: Person provided information about another person to authorities or investigators. Often confidential or sealed.

alleged.label: Alleged
alleged.description: Person made an allegation about another (entity or event). The allegation itself is typically a Statement node; this edge is a graph shortcut.

denied.label: Denied
denied.description: Person denied an allegation or statement.

witnessed.label: Witnessed
witnessed.description: Person observed an event. Source: witness lists, deposition Q&A.

represented_by.label: Represented By
represented_by.description: Person is represented (legally, diplomatically) by another person or organization.

_v02_mention_cluster._doc: Mention ↔ document edges. Mentions are first-class nodes; these edges anchor them to their document/page/paragraph and to their candidate entity.

mention_of.label: Mention Of
mention_of.description: Mention node refers to a canonical entity. Confidence carried on the edge data, not the type.

mention_on_page.label: Mention On Page
mention_on_page.description: Mention occurs on a specific page node.

appears_in.label: Appears In
appears_in.description: Convenience edge from a canonical entity to documents it has mentions in. Aggregate of mention_of + mention_in_document.

has_mention.label: Has Mention
has_mention.description: Inverse of mention_in_document — held on the document so 'all mentions in this doc' is cheap.

_v02_statement_cluster._doc: Statement node edges. Statements are an event subtype carrying speaker + predicate + object + document trail.

said_by.label: Said By
said_by.description: Statement was made by a person.

said_about.label: Said About
said_about.description: Statement is about an entity or event.

stated_in.label: Stated In
stated_in.description: Statement was made in / recorded in a document.

corroborates.label: Corroborates
corroborates.description: Statement or assessment corroborates another. Different from 'supports' — corroboration is independent evidence for the same claim.

contradicts.label: Contradicts
contradicts.description: Statement or assessment directly contradicts another.

_v02_ownership_cluster._doc: Beneficial-ownership and corporate-control edges. The existing owns/owned_by/subsidiary_of/parent_of stay; these add the deeper chain.

owns.label: Owns
owns.description: Entity (person or org) owns another entity. Asset ownership, not corporate parent/subsidiary (use subsidiary_of for that).

beneficial_owner_of.label: Beneficial Owner Of
beneficial_owner_of.description: Person is the ultimate human beneficiary of an organization, regardless of nominal/legal ownership chain. Surfaces shell-company chains. Source: ICIJ Offshore Leaks, OpenCorporates UBO data, Companies House PSC.

ultimate_owner_of.label: Ultimate Owner Of
ultimate_owner_of.description: Top of the ownership tree for a given entity. Distinct from beneficial_owner_of in that the ultimate owner can be another corporation, sovereign, or trust — not necessarily an individual.

shareholder_of.label: Shareholder Of
shareholder_of.description: Entity holds shares in an organization. Edge data carries percentage if known.

founded_by.label: Founded By
founded_by.description: Organization was founded by a person or other organization.

trustee_of.label: Trustee Of
trustee_of.description: Person serves as trustee of a trust or estate (legal control without ownership).

_v02_family_cluster._doc: Family edges. The Wikidata cascade already produces spouse/parent/child/sibling discoveries; these are the formal vocab.

spouse_of.label: Spouse Of
spouse_of.description: Marital relationship. Symmetric in practice, but stored as one direction with the reverse computed.

parent_of_person.label: Parent Of (Person)
parent_of_person.description: Parent-child relationship for persons. Named distinctly from corporate parent_of.

_v02_travel_cluster._doc: Travel / co-presence edges for flight-log, manifest, and event-attendance analysis.

flew_with.label: Flew With
flew_with.description: Two people appear on the same flight manifest. Surfaced from flight_log documents. Symmetric.

accompanied.label: Accompanied
accompanied.description: Person accompanied another person to a destination or event. Different from flew_with (co-presence on a vehicle).

_v02_issue_cluster._doc: Edges connecting issue nodes to the entities/documents they describe. Issue nodes themselves live in the issue category.

candidate_merge_of.label: Candidate Merge Of
candidate_merge_of.description: Collapse-candidate node points to the two entities under consideration.

contradicts_in_doc.label: Contradicts In Document
contradicts_in_doc.description: Contradiction node anchors to the document + span the conflict appears in.

concerns_entity.label: Concerns Entity
concerns_entity.description: Issue node concerns a canonical entity (e.g. a contradiction about a fact about a named person).

employed.label: Employed
employed.description: Entity employed another entity (job, paid position, formal engagement). Inverse: works_for.

appointed.label: Appointed
appointed.description: Authority appointed an entity to a role/position. Stronger than employed; implies a formal designation.

represented.label: Represented
represented.description: Entity acted as legal/political/agent representative of another. Lawyer→client, agent→principal.

introduced.label: Introduced
introduced.description: Entity introduced another entity to a third party. Key edge for network mapping.

claimed_to_know.label: Claimed To Know
claimed_to_know.description: Source claims familiarity with target (often weak signal — 'I know him', 'we met once'). Distinct from communicated_with.

corroborated.label: Corroborated
corroborated.description: Source confirmed/verified/validated a claim made by/about target. Use for affirmative assertion alignments.

hosted.label: Hosted
hosted.description: Entity hosted an event/meeting/gathering — controlled the venue or invited list. Stronger than participated_in.

paid.label: Paid
paid.description: Entity made payment to another entity. Money flow direction: source→target.

received_from.label: Received From
received_from.description: Entity received funds/property/communication from another. Inverse: paid / transferred_to.

transferred_to.label: Transferred To
transferred_to.description: Entity transferred property/funds/title to another. Distinct from paid (which is money-specific).

headquartered_in.label: Headquartered In
headquartered_in.description: Organization's principal place of business is in target place.

traveled_with.label: Traveled With
traveled_with.description: Entity traveled in the company of another. Distinct from traveled_to (destination-anchored).

studies.label: Studies
studies.description: An actor studies or investigates a phenomenon, capability, or subject.

conducts.label: Conducts
conducts.description: An actor conducts a program, experiment, study, or operation.

funds.label: Funds
funds.description: Provides funding/grants to a program, project, or actor.

sponsors.label: Sponsors
sponsors.description: Sponsors or provides cover/backing for a program or actor (e.g. a front organization).

tests.label: Tests
tests.description: Tests a technique, substance, hypothesis, or subject.

administered_to.label: Administered To
administered_to.description: A substance or technique was administered to a subject.

subproject_of.label: Subproject Of
subproject_of.description: A subproject or sub-program is part of a larger program.

proposes.label: Proposes
proposes.description: Proposes a study, method, tool, or course of action.

develops.label: Develops
develops.description: Develops a tool, technique, or capability.

uses_method.label: Uses Method
uses_method.description: Employs or applies a method, technique, or tool.

targets.label: Targets
targets.description: A program or effort targets a capability, phenomenon, or objective.

evaluates.label: Evaluates
evaluates.description: Evaluates or assesses data, results, or a claim.

concludes.label: Concludes
concludes.description: Reports a finding or conclusion about a subject.

authorizes.label: Authorizes
authorizes.description: Authorizes or approves an action, program, or operation.

supervises.label: Supervises
supervises.description: Supervises or directs a program, unit, or person.

reports_to.label: Reports To
reports_to.description: Organizational reporting relationship (unit/person reports to another).

requests.label: Requests
requests.description: Requests authority, approval, resources, or an action.
